chunks: And through his chain of narration, from Ali (peace be upon him), who said: The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) said:
"I am the city of knowledge and Ali is its portal. [Whoever wishes to gain knowledge should go through that portal.]
ai.seo_question: What is the meaning of 'I am the city of knowledge and Ali is its door'?
ai.summary: Known as the 'Hadith of the City of Knowledge' (Madīnat al-ʿIlm), this tradition establishes Imam Ali as the exclusive gateway to the Prophet's spiritual and intellectual legacy, a concept central to Shia hermeneutics. It underscores the inseparable link between the Prophet and the Imams, affirming that true understanding of divine revelation is contingent upon adherence to the Ahl al-Bayt.

en.dr-ali-peiravi: 31-299 According to the same documentation on the authority of Ali (a.s.), God’s Prophet (S) said,
“I am the city of knowledge and Ali is its portal. (Whoever wishes to gain knowledge should go through that portal.)
